evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Creation of a game is a root entity with no prerequisite story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators requires an existing game created by PP-001.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round requires an existing game from PP-001.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing session items presupposes an item list created by item-entry and item-add stories.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item requires existing items in the session list.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding to the list assumes a session/list already started by PP-003.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing an item requires an existing item, such as one added by PP-006.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an item requires an existing item, such as one added by PP-006.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Showing estimates requires a selected item/round for which estimates are being given.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an average requires estimates for a selected item/round.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: The automatic estimate field requires an active item/round and estimator cards.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Recording an agreed estimate requires a selected item to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating requires a previously estimated item and round.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Standalone import feature with no inherent dependency on another backlog story.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Standalone input feature with no inherent dependency on another backlog story.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games requires games to have been created.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a game transcript requires an existing game.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting a transcript depends on the transcript/game data introduced by the transcript story.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting a transcript depends on the transcript/game data introduced by the transcript story.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game requires a game to have been created first.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is a root entity with no prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login requires an account created by PP-021.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Changing account details requires an existing account created by PP-021.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an account requires an existing account created by PP-021.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Cross-cutting localization feature with no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder requires an existing account from PP-021.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with
evaluations.rationale: Standalone game configuration setting with no concrete prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Invitation limit is related to the existing invitation capability from PP-002.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining a game requires an invitation URL, created by PP-002, and an existing game.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Requires a selected item from PP-005.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Requires an existing item list created by item-entry/add stories.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Requires an active item/round for which estimates are being given.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Requires a selected item/round and estimates for that item.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate requires a selected item and an active estimation draw.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Requires a selected story/item and prior estimates.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Requires a current round with a selected item and estimates.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained timer feature with no concrete prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Requires the timer from PP-037 and an active item/round for estimates.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Requires prior rounds and items to exist.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Standalone presentation consistency requirement with no dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate requires an active draw and a selected item.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Personalization feature with no explicit dependency on another backlog story.

evaluations.evidence: written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Cross-cutting technical quality requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained documentation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Technical performance requirement, not a dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Cross-cutting compatibility requirement.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Cross-cutting accessibility requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Cross-cutting performance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Cross-cutting internationalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Cross-cutting usability/design requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Cross-cutting error-handling requirement.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Requires game/estimation results to exist before they can be stored for research.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics require game usage data from existing game functionality.
